basics.name: David (Jiachen) Weng
basics.label: Product Engineer & Creative Technologist
basics.summary: Product engineer and creative technologist in Vancouver. I build things that look good and work well, from brand identities to open-source apps, and I create content end to end, from video production and graphic design to social media marketing, with a proven ability to manage intricate projects from concept to completion. I design agent-native developer tools: a suite of 8 original Go CLIs sharing one machine-consumable contract (monarchmoney-cli with 30 stars, flickr-cli with 47 commands), plus jobs-cli, an agent-first job search CLI. I maintain projects across stacks (Tauri + Rust, Go, Rust + egui) with a local-first philosophy. My work spans product strategy, full-stack development, AI-integrated workflows, and visual design. Co-Founder of OwO Network, LLC.

projects.name: OpenMusic Series
projects.summary: Local-first AI music apps: OpenKara (desktop karaoke) and OpenLoop (text-to-music generation, alpha).
highlights: OpenKara (Rust + Tauri, 31 stars): on-device AI stem separation (Demucs, 2/4-stem), synced lyrics with 13-language romanization, AirPlay casting; ships v0.14.0 as full-platform binaries (dmg, AppImage, deb, exe) with a YouTube demo
OpenLoop (TypeScript, alpha): local ACE-Step music generation from text prompts and lyrics; agent-first CLI with NDJSON streaming for automation pipelines

projects.name: jobs-cli
projects.summary: Agent-native job search and application CLI (Go).
highlights: Searches Indeed and LinkedIn from the terminal, detects the ATS provider behind each posting (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday and others), and submits applications where the provider supports it
Safety-first by design: nothing is ever sent without an explicit --confirm flag; agent-first contract with stable JSON output, separated stdout/stderr, and predictable exit codes
Ships v2.0.2 as single static binaries for macOS, Linux, and Windows via Homebrew tap, install script, and go install

projects.name: Agent-Friendly CLI Tools
projects.summary: A suite of 8 original Go CLIs built on one machine-consumable design contract.
highlights: monarchmoney-cli (30 stars, 3 forks): query and automate Monarch Money from the terminal, with JSONL audit logs, hledger backups, and offline SQLite cache; flickr-cli: 47 commands across photos, albums, and stats; canvas-cli: terminal interface for Canvas LMS; plus zenodo-cli, qualtrics-cli, tg-drive-cli, and money

Every tool ships the same contract: JSON-first output, predictable exit codes, distinct stdout/stderr, and --read-only / --dry-run / --confirm safety gates on mutations; single static binaries with SBOM and checksums, distributed through a personal Homebrew tap

projects.name: lyric-romanizer
projects.summary: Local lyrics romanization engine, published on npm.
highlights: Script detection and romanization across 12 scripts (Japanese, Mandarin/Cantonese, Korean, Cyrillic, Indic, Tamil, Thai), running fully locally with zero API calls; 511 npm downloads in the last 30 days
Powers OpenKara's 13-language synced-lyrics romanization; documented in 9 languages
